review_method: Read-only inspection of candidate code, Main producer/consumer contracts, and authored test source; no candidate or test execution.

actual_promotion_manifest.description: Contains the current three production candidates and two frozen test candidates. This is the manifest inspected for promotion.

fixes_observed.issue: Metadata capacity used compact JSON while the ordinary repair transport serializes spaced JSON.
fixes_observed.resolution: The helper now counts ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True with the default spaced serializer. The compact V10 representation is no larger.

fixes_observed.issue: A global-only rejection or a small negative subset previously rebuilt lookup indexes for all claims.
fixes_observed.resolution: Full claim/binding/source/unit identity checks run first. The zero-negative branch returns without scoped lookup; only negative claim IDs and their corresponding immutable bindings are indexed.

fixes_observed.issue: An unconditional local-patch instruction could conflict with existing complete-draft repair contracts.
fixes_observed.resolution: The prompt follows the existing repair output contract and asks for a local patch only when that contract permits it.

checked_invariants: The actual checker alias-to-canonical reconstruction precedes the new helper call. Canonical binding allowlists are derived from the same current claim's immutable binding table.
Allowed fragments must resolve to the matching evidence owner; duplicate identities and changed recorded exact-text hashes fail closed.
The helper reads but does not mutate original claims, assessment statuses, relations, conditions, or source text.
Already-supported units receive no proposal. Invalid checked unit identities remain rejected before the zero-negative fast path.
Selected lexical coverage is captured before supplement coverage changes; combined coverage is separately reported.
Only precise complete source blocks are eligible. Coarse/incomplete selected blocks produce exclusion records instead of fabricated precise support.
Each supplement contains at most 4 new IDs; global unique supplement IDs are at most 12; total newly proposed complete source text is at most 6000 Unicode code points.

Proposal metadata has at most 12 records and 64 displayed anchor rows per record. The finalizer removes entire trailing proposals/exclusions and recounts retained sources rather than clipping claim or source text.
18 KiB applies to the proposal metadata JSON subtree; it is not a bound on complete repair feedback or the enclosing HTTP request.

Occurrence counts, word-family hints, common source locations, and candidate combinations are explicitly navigation-only. They certify neither predicate ownership, semantic continuation, nor source entailment or semantic absence.
The proposal is attached to the same private_check dictionary already stored in output.checks and to repair feedback. It adds no public answer override.
The claim-feedback codec preserves unknown fields and proves a lossless round trip; the source-text codec restores exact candidate text from unchanged CURRENT_EVIDENCE.
The existing finite revision loop, repair/recheck call reservation, protected-span checks, schema validation, fresh checker, and final-partial publication block are unchanged.
The helper and preparation CLI add no network, authentication, or database calls. The helper adds no domain-answer constants or new regular expressions.

observations: Authored neutralisation, DNS, constant-mass mechanics, and shared-metal-predicate cases are development regressions, not unseen evaluation data or semantic Gold.
Zero-negative planner controls forbid scoped lookup through a failing spy. Malformed supported unit identities must fail before lookup.
Capacity cases inspect both real spaced and compact serializers, stress actual metadata, require whole-record removal, and recount retained source IDs/characters.
Real GenerationService cases retain a protected baseline, send the original local-patch schema, reserve one complete final check, and reject final partial without output.
The encoder spy captures exact trusted codec inputs and returns the unmodified producer result. Marker detection is confined to authored test decoding; no application marker detection was added.

The PostgreSQL test source uses the existing disposable runtime fixture and normal API/worker path, checks frozen request command and budgets, verifies private plan persistence and original partial, and checks canonical publication/reload or zero Answer rows.

remaining_validation: The root writer must run the frozen unit and integration candidates against the promoted current files and record actual outcomes.
Script judgments and mock runtime results cannot establish that a live checker chooses adequate independent sources, resolves predicate ownership, or repairs saved semantic gaps.
The proposed navigation plan must continue to be treated as candidate-only; fresh source and publication checks remain required.
